title: Prepare reconstructed cupolas for the first-fort blockhouses
items: The NW and SE blockhouses request the owner-adopted 1812 cupola prototype. This source checkpoint still awaits its native build and visual review.
The square bodies and pyramid caps use reconstructed kit dimensions. Whistler says they were not yet built in 1808; no completion date is asserted.
The whole-fort picture comparison remains DIFFERS, with the western gateway and other proportions still open.
